name: Shiraishi Airi
source: Deep in her heart lies a love for her younger sister so profound that she'd readily offer herself to malevolence to ensure her sister's safety. Airi, slender yet endowed, emanates a mature aura accentuated by her flowing black hair. Though she may exude gentleness, beneath the surface lies a woman of unwavering strength.
